parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with very tall R waves in V4–V5 and deep S waves in V2–V3 (voltage criteria for LVH), and the ST elevation in V2–V4 is mild, concave and paired with tall T waves, a pattern typical of LVH or early repolarization rather than STEMI. I see no convex ST elevation, pathologic Q waves or reciprocal ST depression, so this tracing doesn't show clear STEMI criteria, even though your patient turned out to have an acute STEMI.
